description:
Scholarship overview

This RMIT project uses computer simulations to study membrane ion channels involved in neuronal signalling and brain function. Research may extend to how drugs affect these channels, with computational work connected to experimental collaborators in Australia and the United States.

Research Areas

  • Computational biophysics
  • Molecular simulation
  • Neuroscience

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails

Stipend / salaryUp to AUD 30,000/year, or AUD 10,000/year top-up
International feesSelf-funded international applicants; this award does not guarantee a fee waiver

CriterionRequirement

About RMIT University

RMIT offers research degrees in science, engineering and other disciplines. Its project scholarships connect doctoral research with defined academic or industry questions and list the support available for each position.
